summary: Iteration 245: Tested Wallet/Network State Mismatch bug fix. All 4 test scenarios passed. The sync useEffect in AppRoutes correctly syncs app-level network state with authUser.network, fixing the bug where logging in on testnet while localStorage had mainnet would cause a mismatch.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix is correctly implemented in App.js lines 1019-1026 with a useEffect that syncs network state
useAuth.js lines 81-82 correctly syncs localStorage during recovery mount
context_for_next_testing_agent: Network state mismatch bug fix verified. Key findings: (1) Setting localStorage to 'btc-mainnet' then creating wallet on testnet correctly updates localStorage to 'btc-testnet', (2) auth_user.network is correctly set to 'btc-testnet', (3) Network toggle on auth page works correctly (switches between BTC Testnet and BTC Mainnet and updates localStorage), (4) Guest browsing still works after the sync changes. The fix uses a useEffect in AppRoutes that watches authUser.network and calls setNetwork when there's a mismatch.

network_state_mismatch_fix.details: Set localStorage to 'btc-mainnet', selected testnet on auth page, created wallet - localStorage correctly updated to 'btc-testnet' and auth_user.network is 'btc-testnet'

localStorage_sync_on_wallet_creation.details: Creating a new wallet on testnet correctly sets localStorage 'cthulhu_network' to 'btc-testnet'

network_toggle_on_auth_page.details: Network toggle switches between 'BTC Testnet' and 'BTC Mainnet' and updates localStorage accordingly

guest_browsing.details: Clicking 'Browse as guest' redirects to /feed page without setting auth_user

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Logging in connects to Bitcoin testnet but the profile section defaults to the mainnet wallet. Users had to double-login (switch to mainnet then back to testnet) to sync states.
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: App.js initializes network state from localStorage.getItem('cthulhu_network') once at mount. When a user logs in via AuthPage and selects a different network, the localStorage value is updated but App.js state remains stale.
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added useEffect in AppRoutes (App.js lines 1019-1026) that syncs network with authUser.network. Also, recovery mount path in useAuth (lines 81-82) now updates localStorage to match recovery.network.
bug_fix_verification.fix_verified: Yes - all test scenarios confirm the fix works correctly
